content:
Camila: Hey team — trying to finish cloud setup for my onboarding project. I need asia-southeast1 quota enabled in project redwood-onboard-camila, and access for my service account (camila-onboard@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com) to a KMS key to decrypt model tokens. Also want billing export to BigQuery for the project so finance can track charges. Who should I ping / what info do you need?
Jordan: @Camila send me the project id and SA email. I can add KMS CryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter and enable the region if quotas allow.
Camila: Thanks — project id is redwood-onboard-camila, SA is camila-onboard@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com. KMS key ring we'll use: locations/asia-southeast1/keyRings/onboard-keys (existing).
Jordan: Copy that. I'll check quotas and create the IAM binding. If billing export is needed we also need a BigQuery dataset in the org billing project or a dataset you own.
Anika: Hi @Camila — finance can create the dataset in billings-prod and grant the billing exporter access, but we need the cost center tag and owner. What cost center should charges be attributed to?
Camila: Cost center is ENG-PLATFORM-ONBOARD. Owner is me (camila).
Mike: FYI, infra requests for region quotas usually take 1–2 hours during business hrs. For KMS binding Jordan can do it sooner. If you want to self-service in future, use the infra-requests template: https://redwood-internal/infra-requests (choose 'GCP region / quotas').
Jordan: Done — I added the IAM binding for the SA:
```bash
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding rdw-onboard-key \
  --location=asia-southeast1 \
  --keyring=onboard-keys \
  --member=serviceAccount:camila-onboard@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter --project=redwood-onboard-camila
```
Jordan: I also submitted a quota bump for asia-southeast1 if we need more CPUs; request id 85214.
Camila: Thanks! Trying encryption test now...
Camila: Test succeeded — I can encrypt/decrypt with the SA. :thumbsup:
Anika: We'll create the BigQuery dataset in billings-prod and set up the billing export once you confirm the billing account id. Send it here or DM.
Camila: Billing account is 0123-ABCD-4567.
Anika: noted, I'll coordinate with billing-admins and update when export is active.
infra-bot: automated note — quota bump request 85214 moved to 'In Review' by cloud-quotas-team.
Jordan: Everything else looks good on infra side. If you hit permission denied errors post-deploy, ping me and include the logs.
Camila: Great, thanks everyone — this made onboarding much smoother.
